caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object resembling an ornately carved wooden frame or stand, positioned at an angle on a plain, off-white background. The object is primarily colored in various shades of brown, with hints of yellow and greenish tones that suggest aged or weathered wood. The top of the frame features a cluster of rounded shapes and leaf-like patterns draping down the sides, while the lower portion is decorated with scrollwork and stylized curves. The central area is open, forming a rectangular space without any backing. The object has structural supports visible behind and below the frame, with the overall shape inclined backward. There are clear details of grain and texture, contributing to the realistic representation of the wood material. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Missal Stand
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
